# Every line below was written by hand; this is not raw tool output the way
# probe-sysfs-tuning.txt is. It reproduces, for testing, the exact combination
# docs/rig/recon-2026-08-31/FINDINGS.md's "The rt-tuning.service contradiction"
# section found on the reference rig on 2026-08-31: every CPU's scaling_governor
# reading powersave AND its energy_performance_preference reading performance at the
# same moment. That is power-profiles-daemon's own "performance" profile on this
# Meteor Lake HWP backend; it never writes the literal scaling_governor=performance
# value GovernorIsPerformanceOnAllCpus requires. probe-sysfs-tuning.txt's own probe
# script never captured energy_performance_preference at all (see this directory's
# README.md), which is why this file exists rather than editing that one. No number
# here may ever be quoted as a measurement or treated as a fresh rig probe.
